_comment: The models the comparison runs and the route chooses between, each through its vendor's API with native tool calling and the same tools. Keys never go in this file: they live in the macOS Keychain under the service names below, saved by bash owner/keys.sh. Prices are US dollars per million tokens, from a check of the vendors' published prices on 2026-10-30, and should be confirmed before the costs go on the page. Cache writes cost cache_write_mult times the input price and cache reads cache_read_mult times it.
route_note: After run B, the cheapest model that clears the bars answers the morning on the page first. Until then the default does.

models.label: GPT-6 Luna
models.reasoning_note: Chat Completions takes function tools for this model only with its reasoning off (run A, 11/9). The Responses API would allow both, at the cost of a second wire format.
